purpose: Track schema and lint debts discovered during deep audit.

repairs_completed.repair: source-record.schema.json now validates current source records instead of requiring obsolete top-level source_id fields.
unified-record.schema.json now permits compact link dictionaries and link arrays.
pattern-record.schema.json added for candidate pattern records.
lint now runs jsonschema validation for ENG, GEN, INF, MET, NEG, PAT, REP, SRC, and unified records.
Hardened INF and PAT schemas and lint so all non-source promoted records carry unknowns and next_actions; backfilled eleven rev0013 records.
Introduced claim.evidence_refs[] and removed legacy source_support from promoted record claims.
Migrated CLAIM-STATUS-LEDGER from sources_or_support to evidence_refs.
Added mandatory pattern red-team/control scaffold validation in lint and pattern schema.
Created GRAPH-EDGES.json as a normalized read surface for links/evidence/source dependencies.
Added source-vocabulary overlay for evidence/permanence major classes.

open_debts.debt: RESOLVED: source_support.source_id overload migrated to typed evidence_refs.
open_debts.next_repair: Monitor new claims for evidence_refs only; remove any reintroduced source_support in lint.

open_debts.debt: links field still has two shapes, but GRAPH-EDGES.json now provides a normalized read surface.
open_debts.next_repair: Make graph-edge generation lossless and eventually canonical.

open_debts.debt: raw source vocabulary still granular, but SOURCE-VOCABULARY-CONTROL-LEDGER overlays major classes.
open_debts.next_repair: Second-review raw/subtype mappings and optionally migrate source records.

open_debts.debt: claims are embedded inside records and mirrored in CLAIM-STATUS-LEDGER, creating dual-maintenance risk.
open_debts.next_repair: Generate claim ledger from record claims or promote claims to first-class files.

open_debts.debt: RESOLVED AS SCAFFOLD: all pattern records now carry control/counterexample/rollback fields; actual controls remain unpromoted.
open_debts.next_repair: Promote first positive and negative controls for a selected pattern.

open_debts.debt: practice-lag is a facet but currently appears through NEG/MET/INF/PAT composites.
open_debts.next_repair: Create practice_surface child records or a shared practice_lag block.

open_debts.debt: schemas are permissive with additionalProperties true.
open_debts.next_repair: Tighten once migration stabilizes; avoid premature rigidity.

schema_closure_state: post_audit_refactor: current records validate, evidence_refs are enforced, pattern controls are scaffolded, but graph canonicalization and locator upgrades remain.

items.title: Introduce CTL control-record schema
items.note: CTL is useful for pattern calibration, but future sessions should audit whether control_role should be a factor axis rather than a record type.
